mapper.insert: insert into ai_video_asset_relation (project_id, from_asset_id, to_asset_id, relation_type, relation_order, metadata_json, create_time) values (#{projectId}, #{fromAssetId}, #{toAssetId}, #{relationType}, #{relationOrder}, #{metadataJson}, now()) on duplicate key update relation_order = values(relation_order), metadata_json = values(metadata_json)

insert into ai_video_asset_relation (project_id, from_asset_id, to_asset_id, relation_type, relation_order, metadata_json, create_time) select project_id, from_asset_id, #{newAssetId}, relation_type, relation_order, metadata_json, now() from ai_video_asset_relation where project_id = #{projectId} and to_asset_id = #{sourceAssetId} and relation_type = 'REFERENCE_IMAGE' on duplicate key update relation_order = values(relation_order), metadata_json = values(metadata_json)
mapper.select: select count(1) from ai_video_asset_relation r inner join ai_video_asset target on target.asset_id = r.to_asset_id where r.from_asset_id = #{fromAssetId} and r.relation_type = 'REFERENCE_IMAGE' and target.asset_type = 'SHOT_KEYFRAME' and target.del_flag = '0'

select source.asset_id as assetId, source.project_id as projectId, source.chapter_id as chapterId, source.scene_id as sceneId, source.character_id as characterId, source.asset_code as assetCode, source.asset_name as assetName, source.asset_type as assetType, source.status as status, source.version_no as versionNo, source.storage_provider as storageProvider, source.object_key as objectKey, source.preview_object_key as previewObjectKey, source.mime_type as mimeType, source.file_size as fileSize, source.width as width, source.height as height from ai_video_asset_relation relation_row inner join ai_video_asset source on source.asset_id = relation_row.from_asset_id and source.del_flag = '0' inner join ai_video_asset target on target.asset_id = relation_row.to_asset_id and target.del_flag = '0' where relation_row.to_asset_id = #{targetAssetId} and relation_row.relation_type = 'REFERENCE_IMAGE' order by relation_row.relation_order asc, relation_row.relation_id asc
